revision: replace single R_deranged with near/mid/far stratified deranged controls; move primary endpoint to A_real vs R_deranged_mid
rationale: R_deranged tests object-specificity, but the semantic/object-function distance of the source word changes difficulty: far is easy (category-only win), near is hard (strongest specificity), mid is the best primary practical test.

R_deranged_near.definition: source word semantically/functionally close to target; same or adjacent concrete-object family; similar object-function where possible
R_deranged_near.role: hard specificity test; strong-form success requires A_real > R_deranged_near

R_deranged_mid.definition: source word concrete and stable but different function family; not obviously opposite or absurd

R_deranged_far.definition: source word concrete but very different function family
R_deranged_far.role: easy control; beating far only = category-level, not word-specific

selection_method.distance_metric: WordNet path / Wu-Palmer similarity (or simple category-distance); thresholds recorded

optional: R_semantic_near (only if not duplicative of R_deranged_near)

primary_endpoint: A_real win-rate vs R_deranged_mid on the primary concrete-object set
success_criteria: A_real beats or adds beyond semantic_only_baseline
A_real vs R_deranged_near reported as hard specificity test; strong form requires A_real > R_deranged_near
if A_real fails near but passes mid/far -> label weaker/category-level, do NOT overclaim word-specificity
kill_criteria: effect appears only against far deranged
near/mid/far sources cherry-picked after tag inspection

interpretation_labels.strong_success: A_real beats near, mid, and far
interpretation_labels.moderate_success: A_real beats mid and far; near remains close
interpretation_labels.failure: A_real fails against mid or far

statistical_reporting.expected_gradient_if_real: far strongest, mid moderate, near weakest
statistical_reporting.required_minimum: A_real must beat mid AND far
statistical_reporting.red_flag: flat or inverted gradient (e.g. beats near but not far)
